data.title: DAMAC Islands
data.about:
DAMAC Islands Dubai is a unique master-planned community inspired by the world’s most breathtaking tropical destinations: Maldives, Bora Bora, Seychelles, Hawaii, Bali, and Fiji. Located in Dubailand, DAMAC Islands offers an exclusive selection of 4 and 5-bedroom townhouses and 6, and 7-bedroom villas. Spread over a massive 30 million sq. ft., it provides a serene escape from the bustling city, with pristine beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and lush greenery to create a tranquil and scenic environment.  

With over 25 exceptional amenities, including stunning pools and state-of-the-art fitness centers, residents can experience unparalleled comfort and convenience in every aspect. DAMAC Islands’s modern architectural approach strongly focuses on embracing the waterfront lifestyle. The properties are meticulously designed, featuring glass-to-ceiling windows that offer stunning Arabian Gulf views. Moreover, the proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road allows residents to easily access Dubai’s major communities and landmarks.

characteristics_module.title: Live the Island State of Mind at DAMAC Islands Dubai, UAE
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location in Dubailand: Situated in one of the most sought-after areas, DAMAC Islands by DAMAC Properties in Dubai offers easy access to the city's main attractions.
  • Diverse Property Options: Featuring a wide range of 4- and 5-bedroom townhouses and 6, and 7-bedroom villas.
  • Island-Inspired Amenities: A paradise of amenities, including the Aqua Dome & Park, Iguanas Park, Jungle River, Hot Spring Spa, and activities like kayaking, paddleboarding, and ziplining.
  • Massive Development Area: Spanning 30 million sq.ft., this vast master community offers expansive space, ensuring privacy and a wide variety of recreational and leisure activities for residents.
  • Unmatched Coastal Living: With pristine beaches, crystal-clear lagoons, and breathtaking waterfront views, DAMAC Islands offers a unique blend of natural beauty and luxurious living in the heart of Dubai.
  • World-Class Developer: Developed by DAMAC Properties, a trusted name in luxury real estate, this project promises high-quality craftsmanship, innovation, and world-class design.
  • DAMAC 1% Payment Plan: Start with a 20% deposit, followed by 1% monthly payments over 40 months. Every 6-8 months, a larger 5% installment is due, offering a balanced and manageable payment structure.

location_tile.title: DAMAC Islands Dubai: Discover Your Coastal Paradise
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
DAMAC Islands Dubai, UAE, is strategically located in the heart of Dubailand, a fast-growing district known for its vibrant communities, family-friendly attractions, and easy connectivity to Dubai’s major landmarks. DAMAC Islands is ideally positioned between two major highways, Emirates Road (E611) and Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road (E311).

Nestled next to Sun City, the location allows residents to enjoy a peaceful island-inspired lifestyle while close to the city’s business hubs, shopping malls, and entertainment venues.

  • 15 Minutes - Sports City, Motor City, DAMAC Hills
  • 18 Minutes - Dubai Investment Park
  • 20 Minutes - Expo 2020 Venue
  • 23 Minutes - Al Maktoum International Airport
  • 28 Minutes Dubai International Airport
